comparison.objective: Candidate removes insert tangs; record moves a monitor out, clips on a light bar, and returns the monitor.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires mandrel stabilization, hammering, and fragment pickup; record requires bimanual large-object repositioning and constrained clip/counterweight installation.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four undamaged insert completions with all tangs contained; record requires the light bar fitted and the monitor restored to its initial under-shelf location.
comparison.reason: Clearance-creating repositioning and clip installation differ from fracture-based finishing.
